company.name: PC Construction
company.description: Established in 1994, PC Construction addresses the need for practical master building solutions. Our hands-on, proactive approach and unwavering commitment to quality and service have transformed us into a premier construction company in South Africa, excelling in high-end luxury residential, commercial developments, timber roof engineering, and traditional thatching.

divisions.title: Luxury Residential
divisions.description: Crafting bespoke private estates, high-end oceanfront villas, and modern architectural residences with flawless attention to detail.

divisions.title: Commercial
divisions.description: Executing premium commercial headquarters, wine estate hospitality pavilions, and luxury retail developments.

divisions.title: Roofing & Timber
divisions.description: Specialising in intricate curved glulam beams, exposed timber trusses, steel flitch plates, pergolas, and architectural ceilings.

divisions.title: Thatch
divisions.tagline: Traditional Thatching & Cape Dutch Historic Restorations
divisions.description: Four decades of master thatching heritage, fire-retardant Cape reed roofs, and historic monument restorations across Southern Africa and abroad.

projects.title: WAVE VILLA
projects.leadQuote: Perched at the foot of Lion's Head, the residence seamlessly connects ocean vistas with raw structural steel, timber overhangs, and refined stone finishes.
projects.narrative: At the foot of Lion’s Head, ARRCC has masterfully reimagined this Atlantic Seaboard home, creating a seamless connection between ocean and mountain views. PC Construction was selected to execute the complex structural concrete, multi-tiered infinity pool, and cantilevered glulam ceiling overhangs, setting a new standard for luxury coastal living.

specifications.structuralSystem: Post-tensioned concrete slabs with structural steel framing
specifications.roofType: Standing-seam zinc roof with integrated LED soffit lighting

projects.title: PEARL VALLEY ESTATE
projects.leadQuote: An intricate exposed timber roof structure boasting curved glulam arches, matte black steel tie-rods, and warm pine ceiling cladding.
projects.narrative: PC Roofing & Timber engineered and installed the sweeping curved roof trusses for this landmark equestrian estate villa. Using sustainably harvested Sugargum and European spruce glulam, the team achieved a column-free internal span of 18 meters, blending structural engineering with architectural warmth.

specifications.structuralSystem: Curved glulam timber arches with concealed flitch plates
specifications.roofType: Exposed architectural ceiling with acoustic backing

projects.title: SILVERBAY MANOR
projects.leadQuote: Cape Dutch heritage meets modern coastal architecture with hand-knotted Cape reed thatch, copper ridge binding, and whitewashed gables.
projects.narrative: Situated along the rocky coast of Shelley Point, Silverbay Manor represents a historic restoration and extension. PC Thatchers harvested high-density Albertinia reed to craft a 350mm thick fire-retardant thatched roof, preserving Cape Dutch heritage while incorporating modern double-glazed glass curtain walls.

specifications.structuralSystem: Eucalyptus pole roof framing with copper wire binding
specifications.roofType: Hand-cut 350mm thatched roof with SATAS fire treatment

projects.title: CONSTANTIA HOSPITALITY PAVILION
projects.leadQuote: A boutique winelands commercial tasting room featuring off-shutter concrete, glass curtain walls, and cantilevered timber trellises.
projects.narrative: Commissioned by a historic Constantia wine estate, PC Construction constructed this modern commercial tasting pavilion. The project integrates floor-to-ceiling double glazing with heavy timber pergolas and off-shutter concrete walls.

specifications.structuralSystem: Commercial reinforced concrete frame with curtain wall glazing
specifications.roofType: Commercial flat roof with green roof garden

projects.title: LA GRANGE DE CABRIÈRE
projects.leadQuote: Restoration of a historic French Huguenot barn with open Sugargum beams and authentic Spaansriet reed ceilings.
projects.narrative: Located in the heart of Franschhoek, PC Construction converted this historic barn into a luxury guest villa. The challenge was retaining the 150-year-old stone walls while installing new loft bedrooms, Spaansriet reed ceilings, and an outdoor braai entertainment pavilion.

specifications.structuralSystem: Historic stone masonry with retrofitted timber framing
specifications.roofType: Exposed timber rafters with natural reed ceiling

projects.title: HOUSE COMBRETUM
projects.leadQuote: Modern residential design rebuilt to capture panoramic views of the Drakenstein Mountains over an expansive outdoor deck.
projects.narrative: Positioned on a dramatic ridge in Durbanville, House Combretum seamlessly connects indoor entertainment lounges with a massive cantilevered timber deck and rim-flow swimming pool.

specifications.structuralSystem: Reinforced concrete skeleton with structural steel tie-backs
specifications.roofType: Insulated flat roof with sedum green planter beds
